metadata.title: Find More Wills and Probate Records for Using Both Ancestry and FamilySearch Together
metadata.author: Genealogy TV
metadata.shortDescription:
Learn how using Ancestry and FamilySearch together can help you find more records so you can build a full probate package of your ancestors. This uses new search techniques being developed now in 2024.

🌳 Link to the FamilySearch Full Text Search https://ident.familysearch.org/identity/login/?state=https://www.familysearch.org/search/full-text
